derivation_contract: Literal full generated masters are immutable. Both pieces are exact integer RGBA slices of the SAME selected master. Concatenating them reconstructs that master byte-for-byte at the pixel level. Master/crop preview exports preserve alpha and RGB wherealpha>16 exactly; only existing low-alphaRGBbleed. Pieces are derived crops, not independent imagegen outputs and not final native texture canvases.
